proposed_fixes.title: ZoomIt retains an old draw hotkey after shortcut changes
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The options dialog may register a new shortcut without unregistering every prior draw/zoom hotkey, or modifier/key encoding may differ on non-US layouts and leave the previous virtual-key binding active.
plan: Compare option-dialog hotkey registration with the startup unregister/register path for draw and zoom bindings.
Ensure old IDs are unregistered before applying new key/modifier values and preserve correct virtual-key semantics on non-US layouts.
Add regression coverage that changes a binding and verifies the old chord no longer activates ZoomIt.
verification: Change the draw shortcut, restart ZoomIt, and confirm the old Ctrl+Alt+number chord no longer activates drawing on US and German layouts.

confidence.rationale: The issue may be stale registration in the settings dialog or a character/virtual-key interpretation mismatch; the German-layout report makes layout-specific behavior material.

comment.body: Thanks for the repeated reports, including the German-layout example where Ctrl+Shift+1 displays as Ctrl+!.
